general: Only when the source shows the logo in the top-right over the photo, keep one logo there at about 18% of canvas width in #5c1e3a with about 7% right margin and about 4% top margin; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a headline with a smaller subline below the logo, keep both right-aligned to the logo right edge in #5c1e3a and #8a4a5e with the headline about 2.2 times the subline size; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows the burgundy bottle and cream jar together, keep the bottle on the left at about 15% of canvas width and the jar on the right at about 22% of canvas width on the same baseline; otherwise keep the source product arrangement.

Only when the source shows the dark #5c1e3a rounded price panel, keep its internal stack centred with the large cream price first, the underlined cream call-to-action below it, and the smallest cream delivery line last, never splitting it into separate elements; otherwise keep the source structure.
